## Problem and change / 问题与改动

Describe the trigger, previous behavior and resulting behavior.

## Validation / 验证

List commands actually run and any remaining limitations.
For layout changes, include before/after pages and PDF comparison results.

- [ ] Relevant tests pass.
- [ ] Documentation and notes match the final behavior.
- [ ] Default school profile and theme geometry are preserved where applicable.
- [ ] New assets have provenance and redistribution permission.
- [ ] Actual third-party inspirations are recorded in the final Acknowledgements section of README.md and README.en.md.
